# Third-party source

`ntia-itm/` is an unmodified source export of NTIA ITM v1.4 at commit
`668e4ab0b31a7ea1e949e4824272955d63e7c731`.

The upstream source and release terms are available at
<https://github.com/NTIA/itm>. HamHeatmap compiles the upstream C++ sources
behind a narrow compatibility wrapper in `crates/propagation/native/`.
